title: Kenorland Supercontinent
summary: Kenorland is a hypothetical Neoarchaean supercontinent, named after the Kenoran orogeny that consolidated the Superior craton near 2.7 billion years ago. Its existence and layout remain disputed: some authors treat it as one landmass holding most Archean cratons, while others argue for several independent supercratons. Its breakup would be marked by large igneous provinces from about 2.45 billion years ago.

uncertainty.note: Cratonization of the Superior craton is dated about 2.72 to 2.68 Ga; assembly of Kenorland is given as late as 2.45 Ga by some authors; breakup is given as 2.25 to 2.1 Ga by some and from 2.45 Ga by others.
